description: City of Zagreb (Grad Zagreb) publishes the sports facilities of the City of Zagreb as a geoportal layer, titled "Geoportal of sports facilities of the City of Zagreb" on the portal. Coverage: the City of Zagreb, Croatia; the layer was created in December 2022 and last modified on 2024-02-06 according to the portal metadata. Format and access: CSV, KML, Shapefile, GEOJSON, File geodatabase, downloadable without registration from the City of Zagreb open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Otvorena dozvola (OD); cost: free. Caveats: the portal description is one line, so attribute fields, feature count and the definition of a sports facility were not read; the downloads are generated from the city ArcGIS Hub. Simulation uses: inventories of public facilities for accessibility, evacuation-shelter and service-demand analyses, and as a layer in urban agent-based or accessibility models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
